title: Case 013: Integrated Dishwasher Repair Request
initial_request: Dishwasher starts then beeps and powers light flashes.  Just stops working. It’s  an integrated dishwasher .
overview: The tenant reported that the integrated dishwasher started, beeped and flashed its power light before stopping. Northbridge Lettings assigned Harbour Surveying, sent appointment reminders, and arranged a visit. The provider later reported the job completed; the agency confirmed the dishwasher had been repaired on site and was working again. The invoice amount was £162.85. Final checks included landlord confirmation and confirmation that the keys had been returned before the request was closed.
outcome: The agency confirmed that the dishwasher was repaired on site and was working again.
